title: Fetch My Story
description: Foster Communication and Pet Bio Generation Application.
Originally developed as a senior proof-of-concept for Angels Among Us Pet Rescue, this project evolved into a fully functional application, available to support all 11,000 Petfinder organizations.
Integrated voice-to-text transcription and sentiment analysis to generate engaging pet bios and improve foster communication.
Lead, designed, and developed an intuitive React based UI using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Material UI, ensuring a seamless user experience.
Expanded the project beyond its initial scope, demonstrating the ability to create real-world, high impact software solutions through technology and secure system design.

title: Work Wise
description: Course: Intro to Software Engineering (Group Project)
Developed a web-based platform designed to assist entry-level job seekers evaluate companies prior to applying.
The application allowed users to rate and review companies based on workplace experience, culture, and benefits, providing insights for prospective employees.
Designed and developed the user interface, ensuring a responsivr and intuitive experience.
Assigned tasks, managed development timelines, and maintained project efficiency.
Led the final code review, debugging, and integration of various components to ensure seamless functionality.
